description: x402 Listing Check: Seller-side pre-listing check: is my endpoint payable by a default x402 client? Fetches any x402 endpoint, reads its 402 challenge, verifies accepts[] (scheme, network, asset, amount, payTo), checks the published input example for placeholders, and measures the challenge against the 8,190 B edge limit. Returns READY / NEEDS_FIX / NOT_X402 / UNREACHABLE with a fix per finding. Use it to check an x402 endpoint before paying it, or before listing a new API.
name: x402-listing-check
